Descriptions

HYDRAULIC HEIGHT ADJUSTABLE: Gentle and slow raising and lowering of the tabletop for longer life.

VERSATILE STORAGE: Two drawers and an open compartment provide ample space for your essentials. HIDDEN STORAGE SPACE: Additional storage space inside the table thanks to a liftable table top.

LED LIGHT: Built-in LED light with color, brightness and color temperature control via Bluetooth APP, so you can see well even in dimly lit rooms or at night.

The combination of practical storage space, innovative LED lighting and the hydraulic lifting function makes this coffee table an indispensable piece of furniture for any modern living room.

The 100*50*44cm hydraulically height-adjustable coffee table combines functionality and modern design in a unique piece of furniture. With its high-quality hydraulic lifting system, this coffee table allows the tabletop to be raised and lowered gently and slowly, unlike traditional models where the tabletop drops abruptly. This innovative technology extends the life of the lifting system and provides comfortable use. This versatile coffee table has two spacious drawers that provide ample space for your personal items such as magazines, remote controls, and other living room utensils. In addition, there is an open compartment that is ideal for decorative items or frequently used items that need to be quickly at hand. The tabletop can be raised, creating additional storage space inside the table. This hidden storage space offers space for books, tablets or other personal items that need to be kept out of sight.

The coffee table is made of high-quality materials that guarantee durability and stability. The sturdy construction and meticulous workmanship ensure that the table can withstand all everyday stresses and tears while making it a stylish piece of furniture in your living room. The combination of practical storage space, innovative LED lighting and the hydraulic lifting function makes this coffee table an indispensable piece of furniture for any modern living room. It is not only a functional piece of furniture, but also a real eye-catcher that adds a touch of luxury and modernity to your living space. Thanks to the detailed assembly instructions, the coffee table is easy and quick to assemble. The clear and understandable instructions ensure that you can use the table in no time. The coffee table adapts seamlessly to different interior styles and is great to combine with other pieces of furniture, making it a versatile addition to your home. With this hydraulically height-adjustable coffee table, you will not only enjoy practical storage space and innovative lighting, but also a stylish piece of furniture that will enhance your living room and create a pleasant atmosphere.
